instruments.title: Cognitive Failures Questionnaire (CFQ)
instruments.format: 25 items, 5-point Likert Scale (0 = Never, 4 = Very Often)
instruments.construct: Measures self-reported lapses in perception, memory, and motor control in routine environments.
sampleItems: Do you fail to notice signposts on the road?
Do you find you forget what you came to the shop to buy?
Do you read something and find you haven't been thinking about it and have to read it again?
Do you find you forget people's names shortly after introduction?
instruments.scoring: Cumulative score 0 — 100; higher values indicate elevated frequency of everyday cognitive lapses.

instruments.title: Spatial Route Recall & Wayfinding Protocol
instruments.developer: Standardized Laboratory Protocol adapted for Campus Wayfinding
instruments.format: Two-phase spatial memory challenge (Exploration phase followed by blinded landmark reconstruction)
instruments.construct: Assesses allocentric mental map construction and direction-distance vector retention without turn-by-turn guidance aids.
sampleItems: Reconstruct sequential landmark topological layout from memory.
Estimate angular heading back to starting origin from terminal vertex.
Draw unguided schematic route corridor with proportional distance ratios.
instruments.scoring: Bidimensional regression accuracy score (0.0 — 1.0) and directional error margin in degrees.

instruments.title: Pearson & Spearman Statistical Association
instruments.format: Bivariate linear regression and monotonic rank coefficient testing
instruments.construct: Quantifies linear and rank-order association strength between machine reliance metrics and cognitive failure distributions.

instruments.title: Human Subject Ethics & Data Governance Protocol
instruments.format: Three-stage ethical verification (Informed Consent, Anonymisation, Debriefing)
instruments.construct: Ensures voluntary participation, zero deception harm, right of immediate withdrawal, and anonymised ID coding.

stages.description: Full disclosure of study objectives, survey duration (~25 min), zero penalty for non-completion, and written voluntary agreement.
All survey responses and spatial metrics linked solely to randomized alphanumeric GUIDs with no PII retention.
Educational summary provided to every participant explaining the nature of cognitive offloading and strategies for balanced digital tool reliance.

tools.name: Thematic Coding
